name: kotlin-coding-practices
description: Coroutine-first, immutable Kotlin coding practices with explicit state models.

interface.longDescription: Guides Kotlin and Android Kotlin development toward structured concurrency, suspending APIs, coroutine-friendly synchronization, immutable values, sealed state models and state machines that enforce state-dependent data invariants, and explicit boundaries around platform APIs that require Java threading or blocking behavior.
defaultPrompt: Review this Kotlin code for coroutine and blocking issues.
Refactor this Kotlin flow to structured concurrency.
Reduce mutable state in this Kotlin implementation.
